*   Best Products Orbit Awards Awards powered by what reviewers actually sayAI Workflow Automation →AI Dictation Apps →   Trending CategoriesEngineering & DevelopmentLLMsProductivityMarketing & SalesDesign & CreativeSocial & CommunityFinanceAI Agents Other Categories Trending CategoriesVibe Coding ToolsAI Dictation AppsAI notetakersCode Review ToolsNo-code PlatformsFigma PluginsStatic site generators  Engineering & DevelopmentVibe Coding ToolsAI Coding AgentsAI Code Editors  LLMsAI ChatbotsAI Infrastructure ToolsPrompt Engineering Tools  ProductivityAI notetakersNote and writing appsTeam collaboration softwareSearchAI Workflow Automation  Marketing & SalesLead generation softwareMarketing automation platforms  Design & CreativeVideo editingDesign resourcesGraphic design toolsAI Generative Media  Social & CommunitySocial NetworkingProfessional networking platformsCommunity management  FinanceAccounting softwareFundraising resourcesInvesting  AI AgentsAI Voice Agents. # hob. ## The professional workspace for your whole agent stack. hob brings multiple models and independent workflows into one professional workspace. Agents can shape the workspace around each task, coordinate through it, and guide you inside it. Run, review, automate, and recover agent work in the same system, so you can direct more parallel work without piecing together the infrastructure. We built hob because coding agents changed the job - but the tools surrounding them are still extremely fragmented. hob turns that growing stack into one professional workspace. But hob isn’t simply a place where you can see multiple agents. The agents themselves are users of the workspace - so you and your agent team are always on the same page. They can shape it around the task, open the context they need, coordinate work through it, recover previous sessions, and guide you inside the app. The workspace becomes part of what your agents can do, so you don’t have to manually connect every step of their work. We’d genuinely love to hear what your current agent stack looks like, and what you’d want your agents to handle themselves inside hob. Also, love the idea of workspace for the agents. @joalavedraWelcome to the hob community! What agent did the work (commits linked back to conversations), what context is going to help with the new issues the agents spawned along the way (issues linked to created conversation blocks) - and how you review that work afterwards (no leaving hob to review and make a few manual tweaks to the code changes, the images generations, the markdown docs, etc).

results.content:
Title: Type.com: A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team | Product Hunt
## A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team. Type is a shared workspace that compounds your team's best AI work. Connect tools once, use any model, and put skills, files, and threads in one place your whole team can see. Build custom apps and automations on a company brain that gets smarter as you work. The idea of a shared workspace that compounds a team's AI work instead of everyone re-typing the same prompts and context every session is exactly the right direction. Onboarding could use a clearer walkthrough of how permissions/access work when multiple teammates connect their own tools into the same shared workspace - it wasn't obvious from the landing page alone. It brings AI work, team context, files, and integrations into one shared workspace. I looked at tools like Claude Cowork, and other AI workflow platforms, but Type feels more focused on team collaboration and shared context. Our thesis is that the teams winning with AI aren't the ones with the most agents, but the ones whose best AI work is visible across the whole team. That's how the work compounds! Type is a cloud, multiplayer workspace where you can share sessions, integrations, skills, automations, and even full blown apps that you build together with your team. We've been obsessed with how team's collaborate in a chat-based context for a decade. We've been testing with a group of early customers and are blown away by what they've built. We can't wait for you to try it and see what you come up with! @fletchrichman it’s a great validation for the product.🙌. Just to make sure that I understand, you can upload your whole company's knowledge and chat with LLMs and team mates? @catalinmpit yup - connect all your existing tools (Drive, Slack, CRM, etc) to create a dynamic company brain, and and then get work done in a shared space with your whole team, switching between any harness or model. Left a review after trying it out - the "company brain that gets smarter as you work" pitch is the right framing, most team AI tools today reset context every session.
